referees.quote: I strongly support the publication of this manuscript in Nature Communications. However, to further strengthen the theoretical modeling and physical interpretations, I suggest the authors to address the following specific points before final acceptance
I am generally supportive of publication in Nature Communications, provided that the following points are addressed: ... Can the authors show at least one additional pressurized contact or sample

The referees have several reservations in the interpretation of the experimental data and the approximations made in the simulations ... before a conclusive judgment on the manuscript regarding publication can be made.
I co-reviewed this manuscript with one of the reviewers who provided the listed reports.

note: All recommendations are taken from Version 0, the first round in this file. There is no sign of a transfer from another journal. R1's points are mostly questions and typo fixes, so I read them as minor revision. R2 asks for new pressurized-contact data, field-dependent spectra at high pressure and quantitative A_u fits, so I read that as major revision. R4 and R5 are Early Career co-reviewers who wrote no report of their own, and the file does not say whose report they co-signed. I assigned them R3's recommendation because R3 writes in the plural ('The referees'), and R4 reappears alongside R3 in round 2 while R1 and R2 write in the singular. This attribution is an assumption, especially for R5. If R4 or R5 actually co-reviewed with R1, their recommendation would be minor revision instead.
